name: diagram-design
description: Pointer to diagram-design (cathrynlavery/diagram-design, MIT): an agent skill that draws forty-five diagram types as one self-contained HTML file with inline SVG in an editorial style, with a brand profile pulled from a website URL and importers for Mermaid, draw.io and Excalidraw. It moves fast and ships its own Claude Code marketplace, so it is installed upstream rather than re-homed here (same posture as rea and understand-anything). This entry documents when to reach for it vs. Excalidraw and Mermaid, the install, and how the brand profiles are made.
